steps.reason_for_choice: Need an initial activity ranking to focus expensive optimization on plausible industrial choices and to determine whether the highest-activity candidate needs parity/reachability analysis.
steps.llm_state_before: No lowest-cost candidate known; all 15 candidates unresolved. Need a first screening that can change industrial choice. Candidate actions considered: COMPUTE_ACTIVITY for all 15 (cost 15 CU), RUN_MC on all (expensive and premature), BUILD_PROCESS_WINDOW full (needed only after selecting a subset), OPTIMIZE_PROCESS for all 15 (15*0.002 CU plus would still need activity/reachability later). Chosen action: COMPUTE_ACTIVITY for all 15 to identify the high-activity tail and likely industrial contenders, since activity is the main discriminator for downstream cost and reachability checks.

llm_candidate_actions.why_considered: Directly identifies feasible cost minima among the likely contenders.
Needed for exact windowed optimization but doesn't select candidates.

steps.reason_for_choice: Candidate_04 has the highest atomic activity and is a strong industrial contender; optimize it first to anchor the cost comparison and assess whether it may be the industrial choice.
steps.llm_state_before: Activity ranking now known. Highest atomic activity is candidate_04 (log10 TOF -3.45), closely followed by candidate_05 and candidate_13; cheapest raw metal is candidate_13 (8 USD/kg) and candidate_03 is the lowest-cost among the high-activity tail but still much less active. Current lowest-cost candidate is unknown. Unresolved candidates: all 15, but industrially plausible subset is candidate_04, candidate_05, candidate_13, candidate_14, candidate_08, candidate_01, candidate_12, candidate_06, candidate_07, candidate_15. Candidate actions considered: OPTIMIZE_PROCESS for the promising 10 candidates (cost 0.02 CU), BUILD_PROCESS_WINDOW full (0.00782 CU) then optimize, RUN_MC on promising optimized candidates (expensive and premature), BACKWARD between high-activity and likely cheap candidates (needs optimized feasible states first). Chosen action: OPTIMIZE_PROCESS for the most decision-relevant subset to identify the lowest-cost feasible candidate and whether the activity leader is also cost leader.
